g.text: From ENSO Forecasts to Heat Fate: 2015 and 2023

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #9b4335

g.text: Frozen RO fit: 2002–2024 | Both events are retrospective | Physical diagnostics are not forecast inputs
(a–d) April illustrates both events; all Feb–Jun starts are retained in the accompanying figures and scores. IRI range is not a probability interval.
Forecasts: ERSSTv5 anomalies (1991–2020), with RO trend restored; IRI provider baselines and information dates are not harmonized.
(e–f) PMM: official SST index, standardized on 2002–2024. Wind: ERA5 stress residual conditional on Niño3.4 and Niño3−Niño4; 1982–2014 reference.
(g–j) SODA3 0–300 m; 10°S–5°N; west / central / east = 160°E–180° / 180°–140°W / 140°W–80°W. Monthly trends: 1980–2022.
Fluxes use mass balance and expected boundary-temperature reference. Integrals join monthly centers (Jan 15–Jun 15; next Jan 15–May 15).
Negative loss means anomalous input. Residual closes the budget but does not identify a physical pathway. RO mean D20 is not this heat budget.
These panels establish temporal and physical correspondence; they do not demonstrate that PMM caused the event or the subsequent heat partition.
